facts.text_en: Collahuasi produced 406,016 tonnes of fine copper in 2025 and 558,611 tonnes in 2024; its first year with reported production is 1998 (Cochilco, Chilean copper mine production by company).
facts.text_es: Collahuasi produjo 406.016 toneladas de cobre fino en 2025 y 558.611 toneladas en 2024; su primer ano con produccion reportada es 1998 (Cochilco, produccion chilena de cobre de mina por empresa).
